description:
With their scans complete, Madd's Villains Spectre Squad have managed to find the closest collection of nests that may contain the Red Terror. Now it must be driven from its lair so its regenerative capabilities are neutralized. 

Download the Terror on Devlan Joint Ops rules FREE: https://assets.warhammer-community.com/eng_terror_on_devlan_mission_pack-xxesbxnr8b-lyb0mbmtbe.pdf
